name: Geometry Dash Timing Analyzer
description: osu!-style timing analyzer for the level editor: song waveform, BPM and tempo-change detection, editable timing points, .osu import / export, metronome, guidelines and local songs.

metronome-offset.name: Metronome offset (ms)
metronome-offset.description: Plays the clicks earlier (positive) or later (negative) to compensate for audio latency.

auto-guidelines.name: Automatic guidelines
auto-guidelines.description: The editor guidelines update by themselves after every timing change (adding, moving or deleting a timing point, analysis, .osu import). Replaces guidelines added by hand.

custom-guideline-colors.name: Custom guideline colors
custom-guideline-colors.description: Draws the guidelines itself in the same bright colors as the timing waveform (white bar/beat, red 1/2, blue 1/4, purple 1/3) instead of GD's built-in green/yellow/orange. These lines are not saved in the level.

auto-use-song.name: Use loaded song in the level
auto-use-song.description: When you load an audio file in the Timing window opened from a level, the level plays that file right away (local song ID).
